newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht firms, interbank rate steady late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht firms, interbank rate steady late.

text.p: The Thai baht firmed against the dollar in late quiet trade on Friday as most players were unwilling to take positions in the U.S. unit ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
"The market was very quiet. Most people squared their positions today," said one dealer at a local bank.
The baht was traded at 25.966/25.969 to the dollar late compared with 25.972/25.975 early, dealers said.
Some selling of dollar for baht was also seen today due to tight liquidity in the money market, dealers said.
The Bank of Thailand set the mid-rate at 25.97 per dollar against 25.93 on Thursday.
The overnight interbank rate was steady at 10.00-10.50 percent compared with 10.50 percent earlier and 10.00-10.50 late on Thursday.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was up to 11.00/12.00 satangs per dollar late from 10.50/11.50 in early trade, dealers said.
